entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling about an order. I... I think I need to make a return, and I just feel awful about it.
I'm sorry to hear that, but I can certainly help you look into it. Do you have the order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-77419. It was for the new Trail Helmet. I've been a VeloFit customer for a long time, and I was so excited, but... things are a bit tight, and I really needed this money back if it wasn't perfect.

I understand. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the Trail Helmet, delivered 18 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh no, there's nothing wrong with it! Your commitment to safety is why I shop with you. It's just... the color. It looked different on the website. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the helmet itself. I feel so guilty, but I just can't keep it if I don't love the color.
I see. It's completely understandable that you want the gear you buy to be perfect for you, and that includes the color. Let me just quickly review our return policy for the helmet.
Okay... I hope it's possible. I was really counting on it.
Alright, I've checked for you. Since the item was delivered 18 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. You are absolutely eligible for a full refund.
Oh, really? Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac! I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. That helps me out more than you know.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I have just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email on file. Just attach that to the package, and you can drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can do for you?
No, that's perfect. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
